#### Load data
```{r load Seurat object}

# load integrated all time points orgnaoid data
seurat <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/organoid_d3_d15_d30_d58_integrated.rds")

```

```{r rename metadata}

# Adjust properly the matadata for the condition ("COCUL" vs "CTRL"), timepoint ("D..."), line (WTC or B7)
library(stringi)

# Timepoint
timepoint <- seurat@meta.data$sample
timepoint <- stri_replace_all_regex(timepoint,
                                  pattern=c("ORG-d3-ctrl", "ORG-d3-cocul", "ORG-d15-ctrl", "ORG-d15-cocul", "ORG-d30-ctrl", "ORG-d30-cocul", "ORG-d58-ctrl", "ORG-d58-cocul"),
                                  replacement=c("D3", "D3", "D15", "D15","D30", "D30", "D58","D58"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)

seurat[["timepoint"]] <- timepoint


# Condition
condition <- seurat@meta.data$sample
condition <- stri_replace_all_regex(condition,
                                  pattern=c("ORG-d3-ctrl", "ORG-d3-cocul", "ORG-d15-ctrl", "ORG-d15-cocul", "ORG-d30-ctrl", "ORG-d30-cocul", "ORG-d58-ctrl", "ORG-d58-cocul"),
                                  replacement=c("CTRL", "COCUL", "CTRL", "COCUL", "CTRL", "COCUL", "CTRL", "COCUL"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)

seurat[["condition"]] <- condition


# Cell line 
line <- seurat@meta.data$sample
line <- stri_replace_all_regex(line,
                                  pattern=c("ORG-d3-ctrl", "ORG-d3-cocul", "ORG-d15-ctrl", "ORG-d15-cocul", "ORG-d30-ctrl", "ORG-d30-cocul", "ORG-d58-ctrl", "ORG-d58-cocul"),
                                  replacement=c("B7", "B7", "B7", "B7", "B7", "B7", "WTC", "WTC"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)

seurat[["line"]] <- line

```

```{r find cluster markers}

Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.2"

table(seurat$sample, seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.2)

cl_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/top_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top50_cl_markers, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/top50_cl_markers.csv")

```


#### Name clusters
```{r name clusters}

DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.2"

seurat$celltype <- factor(setNames(c("Hindbrain neuron", # 0 Hindbrain neuron
                                     "Choroid plexus", # 1 Choroid plexus - TTR, TPBG, TRH, WLS, RSPO2, RSPO3; not top genes but also CLIC6 and HTR2C (https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aaz5626)
                                     "Hindbrain neuron progenitor 1", # 2 Neural progenitor cells (hindbrain)- FGFBP3, PLP1, EDNRB, TTYH1, GPM6B, VIM, PTN, C1orf61, NES, QKI, HES5...HES4, SOX2, PAX3, SOX3 
                                     "Proliferating neuron progenitor", # 3 Proliferating neuronal cells (hindbrain) - HIST1H4C, HMGB2, etc. but also HES5, NES, ..
                                     "Immature choroid plexus 1", # 4 Immature choroid plexus (neuroprotective; AIF-high) - (CRYAB: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.1621314114; GDF15: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4479809/ ; CIB1: https://faseb.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1096/fj.201902966RR; P4HA1 :https://pubs.acs.org/doi/pdf/10.1021/acs.jproteome.0c00934) see also  (Lancaster: https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aaz5626 and http://cells.ucsc.edu/?ds=chporg)
                                     "Immature choroid plexus 2", # 5 Immature choroid plexus (vesicular transport; AIF-mid) - VAMP2, ARF4, ENO2, MAP1LC3B, PGK1, RNMT, SUCO, RAB3A (Lancaster: https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aaz5626 and http://cells.ucsc.edu/?ds=chporg ; an article where they mention that choroid plexus and pia are IBA1 (AIF1) positive https://elifesciences.org/articles/80352)
                                     "Choroid plexus stroma", # 6 Choroid plexus stroma - COL3A1, COL1A2, COL1A1, LGALS1, DCN, TIMP1, LUM (https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aaz5626)
                                     "Forebrain neuron", # 7 Dorsal telencephalic (forebrain) - NEUROD2, NEUROD6, FOXG1, NFIB, BCL11A, SLA (list curated bu Hsiu-Chuan Lin: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ojHAx_vW0p_IJla8hArlIFT7Pc0psUAs3z1CKnTIyk4/edit#gid=420174809)
                                     "Forebrain neuron progenitor", # 8 Dorsal telencephalon progenitors (forebrain)  - C1orf61, SFRP1, FABP7, LHX2, PTPRZ1, EMX2, ... HEY1, SOX2 (list curated bu Hsiu-Chuan Lin: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ojHAx_vW0p_IJla8hArlIFT7Pc0psUAs3z1CKnTIyk4/edit#gid=420174809)
                                     "Hindbrain neuron progenitor 2", # 9 Hindbrain neuron progenitor 
                                     "Retina", # 11 Retina - RORB, RBP1, NEUROD1, NEUROD6, CHRNA3, RAX, DCT, ... PAX6, SIX3, OTX2 (protein atlas and the curated list by Hsiu-Chuan mentioned above)
                                     "Choroid plexus stroma" # 11 Choroid plexus stroma - MGP, COL1A2, COL1A1, COL3A1, LGALS1, TIMP1, etc.
                                     ), levels(seurat@active.ident))[seurat@active.ident])

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
my_levels <- factor(c("Proliferating neuron progenitor","Hindbrain neuron progenitor 1", "Hindbrain neuron progenitor 2", "Hindbrain neuron", "Forebrain neuron", "Forebrain neuron progenitor", "Immature choroid plexus 1",  "Immature choroid plexus 2", "Choroid plexus", "Choroid plexus stroma", "Retina"))
```

```{r stacked violing plot function}

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

## remove the x-axis text and tick 
## plot.margin to adjust the white space between each plot.
## ... pass any arguments to VlnPlot in Seurat
modify_vlnplot<- function(obj, 
feature, 
pt.size = 0,
plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
...) {
p<- VlnPlot(obj, features = feature, pt.size = pt.size, ... )+
ylab(feature) + 
theme(legend.position = "none",
plot.title= element_blank(),
axis.title.x = element_blank(),
axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(1), angle = 0), 
axis.text.y = element_text(size = rel(1)), 
plot.margin = plot.margin ) 
return(p)
}


## extract the max value of the y axis
extract_max<- function(p){
  ymax<- max(ggplot_build(p)$layout$panel_scales_y[[1]]$range$range)
  return(ceiling(ymax))
}


## main function
StackedVlnPlot<- function(obj, features,
                          pt.size = 0, 
                          plot.margin = unit(c(-0.75, 0, -0.75, 0), "cm"),
                          ...) {
  
  plot_list<- purrr::map(features, function(x) modify_vlnplot(obj = obj,feature = x, ...))
  
  # Add back x-axis title to bottom plot. patchwork is going to support this?
  plot_list[[length(plot_list)]]<- plot_list[[length(plot_list)]] +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_line())
  
  # change the y-axis tick to only max value 
  ymaxs<- purrr::map_dbl(plot_list, extract_max)
  plot_list<- purrr::map2(plot_list, ymaxs, function(x,y) x + 
                            scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(y)) + 
                            expand_limits(y = y))
  
  p<- patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 1)
  return(p)
}

```

```{r feature plots}
FeaturePlot(seurat, features = genes, cols = green_feature_cols(10), order = T, pt.size = 0.8, ncol = 4) & NoAxes() & NoLegend()
dev.off()

png("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/dotplot_celltype_genes.png",  width = 3500, height = 3500, res = 500)

dev.off()
```

#### Plot proportions of cells per cluster and protocol.
```{r plot cell proportions}

DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"

# create a dataset
cells_cl <- as.data.frame(table(seurat$celltype, seurat$sample))
cells_cl$Var2 <- factor(x = cells_cl$Var2, levels = org_cocult_levels)

colnames(cells_cl)[which(names(cells_cl) == "Var1")] <- "Celltype"
colnames(cells_cl)[which(names(cells_cl) == "Var2")] <- "Sample"

# Stacked
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/prop_cells_per_cluster.pdf",  width = 6, height = 8)
ggplot(cells_cl, aes(fill=Sample, y=Freq, x=Celltype)) + 
    geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") + 
    ggplot2::theme_classic() + 
    xlab("Cell type") + 
    ylab("Proporion of cells") +
    scale_fill_manual(values= col_sample) +
   theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)) 
dev.off()


# create a dataset
cells_cl <- as.data.frame(table(seurat$celltype, seurat$sample))
cells_cl$Var2 <- factor(x = cells_cl$Var2, levels = c("all"))

colnames(cells_cl)[which(names(cells_cl) == "Var1")] <- "Celltype"
colnames(cells_cl)[which(names(cells_cl) == "Var2")] <- "Sample"

# Stacked
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/prop_all_cells_per_sample.pdf",  width = 6, height = 8)
ggplot(cells_cl, aes(fill=Celltype, y=Freq, x="")) +
    geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    xlab("Cell type") +

    scale_fill_manual(values = col_ct) +

dev.off()
```
